Dónde guardan los brains sus entidades,: Where the brains keep their entities, facts and episodes: the bundled FalkorDB, or a FalkorDB or Neo4j you already run.
El FalkorDB que se instala junto a Mimir: The FalkorDB installed together with MimirSynth, at {{address}}. It needs Docker Compose's «bundled» profile, which the installer turns on when you choose a local database.
Hay más grafos de los que se listan aquí: There are more graphs than the ones listed here.
La base de datos no tiene grafos todavía: The database has no graphs yet: each new brain will create its own.
La eligen MIMIRSYNTH_GRAPH_BACKEND, MIMI: MIMIRSYNTH_GRAPH_BACKEND, MIMIRSYNTH_FALKOR_HOST or MIMIRSYNTH_NEO4J_URI in .env choose it, and they win over anything saved here: change it by editing .env and restarting. To manage it from this page, remove those variables from .env and restart.
La instancia pasará a usar esta base de: The instance will use this database, but what is in the current one stays there. A brain whose graph is not in the new one will look empty until you switch back.
La instancia sigue en la misma base de d: The instance stays on the same database, with the new connection details.
La instancia usa ya la base de datos nue: The instance already uses the new database, without a restart. The previous one's data is still there.
La prueba ha pasado: ya se puede guardar: The test passed: you can save now.
Lo que ya hay en la base de datos. Mimir: What the database already holds. MimirSynth does not touch anything that is not a brain's.
Nadie ha elegido otra, así que se usa el: No other one has been chosen, so the FalkorDB installed together with MimirSynth is used.
Nombre o IP, sin protocolo. Desde el con: Name or IP, without a protocol. From the container, host.docker.internal is your computer.
Para guardar, la prueba tiene que pasar: To save, the test has to pass with these details.
Solo si el servidor tiene usuarios (ACL): Only if the server has users (ACL).
Usa bolt+s://, con el certificado compro: Uses bolt+s://, with the certificate checked.
Vacío = la base de datos por defecto del: Empty = the server's default database. Every brain lives in it, each with its group_id.
Viene de las variables de entorno: It comes from the environment variables
{{label}} en {{address}} responde, acept: {{label}} at {{address}} answers, accepts the credentials and allows writing.
